criteria_per_entry.closed_trades_gte: quarter of its BTC 2020-2025 annual rate (trend_pullback 9, funding_momentum 14, vol_breakout 3)

review.meaning: An entry that passes on six months of genuinely new data becomes a candidate for a small live account (Phase 6). Anything else stays shelved.
review.note: vol_breakout trades about 10 times a year on BTC, so six months will not be enough to judge it

adding_entries: New rules are added as NEW entries with their own registered date and scoring_start = the day after registration. Existing entries are never edited; the runner refuses to run if an entry's rules change.
